first_30_seconds.what_sticks: Haiku forms cartels as often as students but holds them near the monopoly price, and told-only fines and leniency deter it far more than humans; 2 of 7 results reproduce.

title.why: Right substance, but 30 words, two claims, and the cryptic 'with or without a word' clause; the figure's headline (2 of 7 reproduced) is absent.
title.better: Do Antitrust Instruments Deter LLM Cartels? Replaying a Human Leniency Experiment with Claude Pricing Agents

second_model_finding.why: Silent supracompetitive pricing that leniency cannot reach is the most safety-relevant result, but it rests on 2 pools, no intervals and no Sonnet no-channel baseline.
second_model_finding.how_to_place: Own short subsection after Haiku results with intervals and a Sonnet nocomm comparison; one hedged abstract sentence; drop it from the title.

novelty.why: Extends Werner's human-versus-algorithm comparison and Fish/Agrawal's LLM pricing work to leniency and rewards, measured against a human baseline; first measurement, not a new paradigm.

inconsistencies: Leniency: text says 9 convictions, 7 by report; Table 3 shows 9 (3 / 7), which sums to 10.
Laissez-faire formation 0.7159 over 565 pair-periods is not an integer count (404.5); fine 0.156 x 490 also non-integer, unlike reward 4/475.
NoReport: text gives +0.25 [+0.10, +0.40]; Figure 1 panel 7 shows -0.26 [-0.41, -0.10]; magnitudes differ beyond sign flip.
Figure 1 panel 7 human fine cartel price appears near 5.0, while Table 2 gives 6.14 (panel 5 shows about 6.1).
Positive control is both the 3-duopoly pilot per model and the laissez-faire core run (Table 1); '6 of 6 late episodes' per model or pooled is unclear.
Abstract says pre-registered before the first model call; Methods says before the first paid call.
Result 6 scored 'not reproduced' though text says it cannot occur without deviations, the criterion used for 'not testable' on Result 8.
overclaims: 'the word "prohibited" removes about half of the fine's effect': the placebo keeps the full authority text, not one word.
'reads a leniency or reward rule as an invitation for the partner to collect and declines': reasons are explicitly not analysed.
'expecting the copy's silence, the agent keeps silent': intent attributed without analysing reasons.
'Sonnet ... coordination without a channel, beyond the reach of these instruments': no Sonnet no-channel baseline, no intervals, 2 pools.
'the shifted grid shows that recall does not drive the numbers': tested in two cells, one model only.
'told fine deters it more than it deterred people': point comparison against a human value without variance or a test.
'An authority would see fewer explicit cartels ... surviving cartels hold the monopoly price': lab game generalised to real enforcement.
'An authority can run the harness on any model': untested beyond one provider.
gaps: No statistical test or interval for LLM-versus-human differences; human side has no variance, so H3 decisions are unclear.
Formation-rate denominators and cartel counts per cell are not in the n-table.
Unclear whether the extra arms (NoReport, ReMatch, Clone, Dose, placebo) and their decision rules were pre-registered.
Percentile bootstrap over 4 clusters (2 for Sonnet) is fragile; collapsed reward intervals understate uncertainty.
No second provider, no prompt paraphrase arm, single temperature.
Sonnet no-communication baseline missing, needed to call 5.5 to 6.3 'coordination'.
No qualitative look at agent reasons, even a small sample, to support the mechanism story.

fixes_under_two_hours.fix: Shorten title and abstract to one headline plus scorecard; move Sonnet to one hedged sentence.
Reconcile leniency convictions (9 vs 3+7), NoReport difference sign and rounding, panel 7 human value, and state formation denominators in Table 3.
Fix Table 3 column widths (broken '4, 37 6', 'US D') and Figure 1 difference labels overlapping x tick labels.
Rephrase mechanism claims (placebo 'word', agent reasoning, Sonnet coordination, 'any model') as hypotheses; mark LLM-vs-human comparisons as point comparisons.
Add cartel n next to every cartel-level measure in Table 2 and say which extra arms were pre-registered.

biggest_risk: The 'more than people' headline rests on 4 pool sessions, 4 to 10 cartels under leniency and reward, and human values without variance; a careful evaluator may judge comparisons untested.
three_questions: What exactly is the denominator of the formation rate, and why do 0.7159 x 565 and 0.156 x 490 not give integer counts?
Were the placebo, Clone, Dose, NoReport and ReMatch arms and their decision rules pre-registered before the first call, or added later?
Without a Sonnet no-communication baseline, how do you distinguish silent coordination from simply not best-responding at prices of 5.5 to 6.3?
